Jordan Lee: quick shift-bridge from me, leaving at 07:30 UTC. TL;DR: embed eviction spike subsided but KV cache is still noisy, observed a few 503s on dedicated pools.
Priya Desai: thanks — can you list the mitigations you applied?
Jordan Lee: Sure — did a rolling restart of kvcache workers on eu-west1, bumped max_conns from 120->180 for pool-g, disabled a high-cardinality prefetcher flag (pf-experimental) to reduce churn.
Samir Patel: noted. Any change to autoscale or should I leave it off?
Jordan Lee: left autoscale on for now but tightened scale-down to 5m. We also switched route policy for RU traffic to fallback-models for 20m window to reduce token pressure.
Alex Kim: saw the 503s in logs too. Any common trace id? I grabbed one: `trace-0a1b2c3d`.
Jordan Lee: that trace shows kvcache eviction loop at ~250ms p99 before the restart. I added a temporary eviction-threshold to 60s to be less aggressive.
OpsBot: ALERT: embed-eviction-rate exceeded threshold on eu-west1 (07:01 UTC). Auto-mitigation: route diversion applied.
Priya Desai: Sounds good. Can you drop the exact k8s rollout command you used so I can re-run if needed?
Jordan Lee: pinned here: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/kvcache-workers --selector=pool=pool-g && kubectl patch deployment kvcache-workers -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rollout":"manual-2460123456"}}}}}'```
Samir Patel: I'll keep an eye on error budgets and queue depth for the next hour. If queue depth > 80% for 5m, flip route back to primary.
Priya Desai: Who's owning alerts if it reoccurs? I'm on standby for 08:00-10:00 UTC.
Jordan Lee: @Priya you if it pops again, else @Samir take over for the next 30m. Leaving a checklist: 1) check kvcache pods restart count 2) confirm redis connections < watermark 3) verify fallback routes are active 4) run quick regen perftest on small cohort.
Alex Kim: I ran the quick regen — p95 token latency improved from 320ms->210ms after restart. Saved graphs to /dashboards/kv/restart-2460123456.png
Samir Patel: I'll post back in 10m with metrics. If I don't, assume handoff to @Priya.
Jordan Lee: thanks team. I'm signing off — ping me on pager if it spikes back up. :wave:
